purpose: One prespecified output-coordination candidate on existing actually-active projection/rate constraints. Not an invented hard-amplitude condition and not a gain sweep.
motivation: R33 same-input diagnosis shows large angular admitted/request disparity; R34 gradient capping did not improve synchronization. Test whether output projection geometry, rather than increased learning, can retain angular compensation intent.

Sum corresponds to NN angular compensation under configured mapping. Preserve original enumeration for remaining ties.

localClaim: On the same input/state and unchanged nonempty feasible normal set, synchronization-component target discrepancy cannot exceed the original Euclidean allocator's. This is not actual synchronization-error improvement, energy monotonicity or stability proof.
verification: Float/double100000 allocator fixtures: enabled vs disabled exact baseline, independent exhaustive normal-set objective and every final envelope/sector bound. Exact disabled recurrent snapshot replay; changed enabled replay is not a physical counterfactual.

candidateToPaperStatus: Unproven candidate, not final innovation or completed evidence loop.
